messages:
nina (Head of Billing): Quick company-wide note: we’re introducing a 7-day soft-overage forgiveness window + reallocating startup credits into a rolling monthly surplus. This goes live 2024-09-01 UTC. Pls read and surface concerns.

nina (Head of Billing): Summary: 
1) Soft-overage: small overages (<= 5% of monthly commit or $25, whichever is smaller) will be held for 7 days before invoicing. During that window we attempt auto-adjust (route smoothing / throttling) and notify customers.
2) Surplus allocation: instead of a one-time onboarding credit, new accounts receive a 3-month rolling surplus bucket that decays weekly. It appears on invoices as `surplus_rollover_credit`.

omar (Product): Rationale: customers with spiky traffic got surprise charges because minute-level metering and invoice cutover didn’t align. This reduces noise and gives customers short buffer to stabilize.

jess (Finance): Invoice change: new line item `surplus_rollover_credit` and a memo field `soft_overage_pending` for held overage. Please note that cash recognition rules mean held overages are recognized when invoiced, not when held.

kai (Eng): Implementation detail: we’ll add an account flag `surgeProfile` to control behavior: "forgiving"|"balanced"|"strict". Default for existing accounts is `balanced`. API example: ```json
{ "accountId": "acct_123", "surgeProfile": "forgiving" }
```

rachel (Support Lead): Need canned responses: "What is a soft-overage?" "How long until I'm billed?" I’ll draft and share. Also will add a line to the onboarding checklist.

nina (Head of Billing): Ops: our billing pipeline will mark held overages with status `pending_grace`. They are visible in the usage UI and in the CSV export. Ensure UI team surfaces it clearly.

kai (Eng): Telemetry plan: emit `overage_held` event with reason (`minute_lag`, `route_spike`, `billing_cycle`) + account profile. Also add `surplus_applied` events for each invoice.

omar (Product): Customer-facing note: this is not free usage. The surplus offsets billed charges until exhausted. After 7 days, held overages are invoiced normally.

jess (Finance): For trial/test accounts: surplus buckets will be smaller (30% of the normal amount) and will not be refundable. Accounting has approved.

rachel (Support Lead): Q: will this affect rate limits or throttles? A: No change to hard rate limits. Soft-overage only affects billing and short-term smoothing.

announce-bot: Docs deploy scheduled: 2024-08-20 10:00 UTC. Customer email scheduled: 2024-08-22 17:00 UTC.

nina (Head of Billing): Action items: @kai add API flag, @omar update changelog language, @rachel draft customer FAQ + canned replies, @jess verify invoice mappings. I’ll draft the public blog post and internal playbook.

kai (Eng): Will add backward-compatible handling: unknown `surgeProfile` values -> treated as `balanced` for one release.

jess (Finance): Will coordinate with collections for edge cases where held overage persists >30 days.

rachel (Support Lead): Will prepare escalation matrix for customers who see unexpected held charges post-launch.

nina (Head of Billing): Thanks team. If anyone needs an exception for a partner or pilot, ping me. :white_check_mark:
